title: Tyranitar 088/189 Holo Rare Sword & Shield Darkness Ablaze Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Tyranitar card from the Sword & Shield set of the Pokémon Trading Card Game features a stunning holo finish and is a Stage 2 Pokémon. It has the card number 088/189 and is a Holo Rare card. The card depicts the fierce Tyranitar, a Dinosaur-type Pokémon, and is in English language.

This card is perfect for collectors and players alike, and is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection. Manufactured by Nintendo in the United States, this card is suitable for ages 6 and up. Get ready to add this amazing card to your collection or use it to strengthen your deck!
